7. Which of the following compounds is not electro conductive in water solution?

a. $\text{NaCl}$
b. $\text{CaCl}_2$
c. $\text{HCl}$
d. $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6$ (Glucose)

1.

(Here X and Y are symbolic. Not symbols of any element)

a. What is a covalent bond?
b. Why is there a difference in the size between $\text{Na}$ and $\text{Na}^+$ ions?
c. What kind of bond is there in the compound $\text{YX}$ of the stem? Explain.
d. Though X is capable of forming both covalent and ionic bonds, element Y never goes into covalent bonds — Explain with logic.

2. Read the following stem and answer the questions
(a) $\text{CH}_4$ (b) $\text{NaCl}$ (c) $\text{CCl}_4$ (d) $\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$

a. What is a covalent bond?
b. Why is water a polar compound? Explain.
c. Which compound of the stem forms a crystal? Explain
d. The compound (b) of the stem is soluble in water but compound (c) is not. Analyze
